# polaris_policy (Resource)

Manage a Polaris policy. Deletion unregisters without purging object data. Nonempty parent deletion is refused by Polaris.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_policy" "example" {
  catalog   = "warehouse"
  namespace = ["sales"]
  name      = "chosen"
  type      = "system.data-compaction"
  content   = jsonencode({ version = "2025-02-03", enable = true, config = { target_file_size_bytes = 134217728 } })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Containing catalog.
- `name` (String) Stable object name. Import existing names before applying.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace path components; dots remain literal.
- `type` (String) Server-supported maintenance policy type.

### Optional

- `content` (String) Policy content, validated by Polaris for its policy type.
- `description` (String) Policy description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `metadata_json` (String, Sensitive) Current object metadata, excluding response credential-vending configuration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polaris_policy.example '{"catalog":"warehouse","namespace":["sales"],"name":"chosen"}'
```
